config.comment: twarp dev fleet work-ledger. The dispatcher leases items whose deps are merged, whose touches are disjoint from every other leased item, and that are not behind an active barrier. build_node is the single machine that owns building/testing (warm cache + working toolchain); screen-bound UX gates also serialize there via a semaphore.

items.title: Unit tests for util/truncation.rs
items.task: app/src/util/truncation.rs has two pure functions (truncate_from_end, truncate_from_beginning) and NO tests. Add a thorough unit-test module for them. Cover: empty string, max_length 0, text shorter than max, text exactly max, text longer than max (both directions), and a multi-byte/unicode string near the boundary. Wire the tests as a sibling file the same way other util modules do it: add `#[cfg(test)] #[path = "truncation_tests.rs"] mod tests;` to truncation.rs and put the tests in app/src/util/truncation_tests.rs with `use super::*;`. Do NOT change the two functions unless you find a real correctness bug (if you do, fix it and add a test that proves it). Keep the change to only those two files.

items.title: Edge-case tests for prefix::longest_common_prefix
items.task: app/src/prefix.rs has `longest_common_prefix` with an existing test sibling app/src/prefix_tests.rs. Strengthen coverage by ADDING edge-case tests to prefix_tests.rs (do not remove existing ones): empty input iterator, a single string, strings with no common prefix, identical strings, a common prefix that ends mid-multibyte-char must not split a UTF-8 boundary, and an input containing an empty string. If any test reveals a real bug in longest_common_prefix, fix the function minimally and keep the test. Keep the change to only prefix.rs and prefix_tests.rs.

items.title: Edge-case tests for util/time_format duration formatting
items.task: app/src/util/time_format.rs has pure duration-formatting functions (human_readable_precise_duration, human_readable_approx_duration) with only a few tests in app/src/util/time_format_tests.rs. ADD edge-case unit tests (do not remove existing ones): zero duration, sub-second, and the boundaries around 1 minute / 1 hour / 1 day, plus the sentence_case=true vs false variants of human_readable_approx_duration. Follow the existing tests' style for constructing Durations. If a test reveals a real bug, fix it minimally and keep the test. Keep changes to ONLY time_format.rs and time_format_tests.rs.

items.title: Edge-case tests for util/openable_file_type extension checks
items.task: app/src/util/openable_file_type.rs has pure extension-based predicates: is_supported_code_file, is_supported_image_file, is_runnable_shell_script. It already has a #[cfg(test)] module. ADD edge-case unit tests (do not remove existing): no/unknown extension, uppercase extension, dotfile, and one representative supported case per predicate. Follow the existing tests style. If a test reveals a real bug, fix it minimally and keep the test. Keep changes to ONLY app/src/util/openable_file_type.rs.
